back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother.
They played the harlot in Egypt, behaving promiscuously from their youth. There their breasts were fondled, and their virgin bosoms were caressed.
The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah. They were Mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their names, Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
Oholah played the harlot while she was still Mine. She lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians, who were warriors nearby—
clothed in blue, governors and officials, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
She lavished her lust on them, on all the elite men of Assyria, and she defiled herself with all the idols of everyone she lusted after.
She did not abandon the harlotry she began in Egypt, where men had slept with her in her youth, caressed her virgin bosom, and poured out their lust upon her.
Therefore I handed her over into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the Assyrians she lusted after.
They exposed her nakedness, seized her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword. So she became a byword among women, and they executed judgment against her.
Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and harlotry she was more depraved than her sister.
She lusted after the Assyrians—governors and officials nearby, warriors splendidly dressed, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.
I saw that she too had defiled herself; both of them walked the same path.
But she carried her harlotry even further. She saw figures of men portrayed on the wall, images of the Chaldeans drawn in vermilion,
wearing belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers, like the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their birth.
As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them in the land of Chaldea.
Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and defiled her with their lust. But after she had been defiled by them, she turned away from them in disgust.
When she openly played the harlot and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.
Yet she increased her harlotry still more, remembering the days of her youth when she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
She lusted after their lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of horses.
So you returned to the lewdness of your youth, when the Egyptians caressed your bosom and embraced your young breasts.
Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I will rouse your lovers against you, those from whom you turned away in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side—

the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa, together with all the Assyrians—all of them desirable young men, governors and officials, officers and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.

They will come against you with an army of peoples, with weapons, chariots, and wagons. They will array themselves against you on every side with large shields, small shields, and helmets. I will set judgment before them, and they will judge you according to their own rules.

I will set My jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your nose and your ears, and the remnant of you will fall by the sword. They will seize your sons and daughters, and the remnant of you will be consumed by fire.
They will strip off your clothes and take away your beautiful jewelry.
So I will put an end to your lewdness and the harlotry you began in the land of Egypt, and you will not lift your eyes to them or remember Egypt anymore.
For the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I will hand you over into the hands of those you hate, into the hands of those from whom you turned away in disgust.

They will treat you with hatred and seize all that you have toiled for; they will leave you naked and bare, and the nakedness of your harlotry will be exposed, along with your lewdness and your promiscuity.
These things will be done to you because you played the harlot after the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.
You have walked the same path as your sister; therefore I will put her cup into your hand.
The Lord GOD says this: You will drink from your sister's cup, a cup deep and wide. It will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.
You will be filled with drunkenness and grief, with the cup of horror and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
You will drink it down and drain it dry; you will gnaw its broken shards and tear your own breasts. For I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.
Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Because you have forgotten Me and cast Me behind your back, you must bear the punishment of your lewdness and your harlotry.”
The LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.

For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols, and they even offered up their children, whom they bore to Me, burning them as food for their idols.
Moreover, they did this to Me: on that very same day they defiled My sanctuary and profaned My Sabbaths.
On the very day they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My sanctuary to defile it. Behold, they did this inside My house.
Furthermore, you sent for men coming from far away, to whom a messenger was sent; and behold, they came. For them you bathed, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with jewelry.
You sat on a luxurious couch with a table spread before it, on which you had placed My incense and My oil.

The sound of a carefree crowd was around her; drunkards were brought in from the wilderness along with common men from the great multitude, who put bracelets on the wrists of the two women and beautiful crowns on their heads.
Then I said of her who was worn out by adulteries, ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is what she is.’
They slept with her as one sleeps with a prostitute; so they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.
But righteous men will judge them with the sentence of adulteresses and the sentence of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is on their hands.
For the Lord GOD says this: Bring up a mob against them and give them over to terror and plunder.
The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn their houses with fire.
So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, so that all women may be admonished not to imitate your lewdness.
They will repay your lewdness upon you, and you will bear the punishment for your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
